text:
incident-bot: 🔔 P1 — capacity-tier routing anomaly detected. Large volume of hosted traffic is being routed into a Dedicated pool (pool-nyc-2). Incident ID INC-2026-0421. Auto-page to #incidents and @oncall.
Alice Chen: Acked. I'm nearby, will coordinate. @Maya you're on rotation right?
Maya Singh: Yep I'm oncall. Looking at traces now — seeing a sudden spike starting ~1912345600 where hosted requests get tagged with 'dedicated_binding' and accepted by pool-nyc-2.
Ben Patel: Confirmed. Customer-facing metrics: acme-payments-prod is seeing 5xxs up ~22% and their SLA alerts are firing. Sounds like noisy-neighbor on dedicated.
Jordan Lee: Diving into policy-engine logs. I see a coincident rollout from earlier today: routing-policy v1.14 introduced a new 'tier-drain' heuristic that sets spillover_target=different_pool for overload. The heuristic mis-classified hosted->tier=dedicated for requests with header X-tenant-hint missing.
Maya Singh: Can you paste the failing rule id/line?
Jordan Lee: snippet below:
```
if (load>0.8 && tenant_hint==null) {
  spillover = allocate_pool('dedicated', prefer_local=false)
}
```
We forgot to gate on request_source=="hosted". That makes hosted requests eligible to be spilled into dedicated pools.
Priya Kumar: Oof. That explains it. Immediate mitigation options: 1) disable spillover heuristic globally; 2) add a quick guard to ignore hosted requests; 3) drain pool-nyc-2 and evacuate dedicated tenants. I'd vote 1+3 to stop impact fast then patch.
Maya Singh: Agreed. I'll disable spillover flag now and start a drain job on pool-nyc-2. @ops-bot can you run the disable command?
ops-bot: Command queued: `config set routing.spillover.enabled false --env prod` — executing...
ops-bot: Command succeeded. routing.spillover.enabled = false
Maya Singh: Okay spillover disabled. Starting drain: `poolctl drain pool-nyc-2 --grace 30s --evacuate-tenants`.
ops-bot: Drain job started for pool-nyc-2. 12 active tenants to evacuate, prioritizing dedicated-owner tenants.
Ben Patel: Seeing immediate drop in acme-payments-prod 5xxs to baseline within a minute. Partial mitigation confirmed. Thanks.
Jordan Lee: Patching policy in staging: adding `if request_origin=="hosted" then skip_spillover` and adding unit tests. Creating PR #3628 now.
Alice Chen: Good. Also need to reconcile why tenant_hint was missing for hosted requests — that feels like a client-side header change or an upstream proxy. @Morgan can you check gateway change logs around 1912345500?
Morgan Alvarez: Checking APIGW changelog — there was a config rollout that stripped 'X-tenant-hint' for requests served via new CDN edge. Rolling back that tiny edge change will help avoid misclassification but we already disabled spillover so risk reduced.
Priya Kumar: Actions so far: 1) disabled spillover (ops-bot) 2) drain pool (ops-bot) 3) PR created to fix policy (Jordan) 4) APIGW edge rollback in progress (Morgan). Any customer communication needed?
Ben Patel: I've opened a SEV ticket for acme-payments-prod and notified their CSM. Suggested message: short apology, mitigation steps, and ETA for full rollback and follow-up postmortem.
Maya Singh: I'll keep the incident open until pool drained and all dedicated tenants back to normal. Current status: impact reduced, acme 5xxs back to baseline. ETA full drain ~5m.
ops-bot: Drain complete. All 12 tenants evacuated. pool-nyc-2 marked standby. Tenant isolation restored.
Jordan Lee: Merged hotfix in staging. Will promote once we confirm no regressions. PR #3628 includes guards and a unit test for tenant_hint-null handling.
Alice Chen: Suggest follow-ups: postmortem, include checklist to gate spillover on request_origin, improve observability for tenant-hint presence, and add quick rollback play to runbook.
Maya Singh: Agree. Filing postmortem now — assigning to Jordan & Morgan for root cause and remediation writeup. I'll mark incident resolved in 30m after verifying no regressions.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 moved to 'mitigated' by Maya Singh. Parties: acme-payments-prod, pool-nyc-2. Postmortem requested.
Ben Patel: Nice quick work everyone. No customer escalation needed at exec level for now but keep CSM looped.
Priya Kumar: Also note: add automated alert if spillover routed->dedicated > 1 request/min for a tenant. That would've caught earlier.
Maya Singh: Noted. I'll add that to the ops backlog item.
Alice Chen: Thanks team. Postmortem timeline: draft in 48h, final in 7 days. Closing thread once postmortem created.
Morgan Alvarez: Edge rollback completed. Verified X-tenant-hint is present again for hosted flows.
Jordan Lee: Follow-up tasks created: 1) policy fix prod rollout plan, 2) extra unit tests, 3) runbook update. Assigning owners in the ticket.
Maya Singh: Closing incident here. Will ping when postmortem link is ready. :white_check_mark:
